gigs.name: Bloodworks Northwest Research Donor Program
gigs.payText: $50 for a blood sample, $100 for a whole blood unit, or up to $150 for a unit of platelets. White blood cell donations are also paid.
gigs.who: Healthy adults 18+ with good veins. You can join even if you can't give to the regular blood supply.
gigs.how: Fill out the My Donation form on the research page. Bloodworks Bio will contact you to pick a donation type.

guide.what: The link for you. Fill it in and Bloodworks Bio will help pick your donation type.

gigs.note: The donation form is lower on the page.

gigs.name: Fieldwork
gigs.payText: $50–$100 per study.
gigs.who: Adults in major US cities, plus online.
gigs.how: Join the database and get called for studies.

guide.what: The button for you. Join their database so they can call you for studies.

gigs.name: Bungie User Research
gigs.payText: In-person playtests in Bellevue pay about $50 an hour in gift cards, plus a small travel fee depending on distance. A 30-day remote Marathon study paid a $500 thank-you.
gigs.who: Players with a Bungie.net account who opt in to research emails.
gigs.how: Turn on research invites in your Bungie.net account email settings (or the user research sign-up page), then answer invites for playtests, interviews, and surveys.

guide.what: Sign in with PlayStation, Steam, Xbox, Epic or Twitch, then finish the research sign-up here.

gigs.note: You need a free Bungie account: sign in there, then fill the research form.
